items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 26 August 2026 at 4:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Slow-moving area of low pressure to the southwest of Britain, with associated weather fronts drifting northwards.


##Wind##

East 3 or 4, increasing 4 or 5 overnight, decreasing east or northeast 3 or 4 tomorrow afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Mainly slight.


##Weather##

Showers, becoming mainly fair overnight, rain spreading from the south later, possibly heavy in places.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain or showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

East or northeast 3 or 4, soon becoming cyclonic 2 to 4, then west or northwest 4 or 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Mainly slight.


##Weather##

Rain spreading from the south, heavy in places, becoming mainly fair later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain.
